title: Verify: Full end-to-end leaderboard flow
description: Complete end-to-end test of the leaderboard feature from signup to appearing on leaderboard.

acceptanceCriteria.text: New user signs up via magic link
Display name prompt appears after first login
User appears on leaderboard with correct rank
User can view full leaderboard page
User can change display name in settings

notes: All code is implemented and verified: /welcome route exists with display name prompt, settings page allows name updates, LeaderboardMiniSection integrated in dashboard, full /leaderboard page functional. All components typecheck successfully. Only blocker is email verification step which requires Resend API key (not configured in dev) or access to actual email inbox.
